experiences.title: Bound retries for an idempotent queue
experiences.problem: A worker repeats a stalled operation indefinitely.
experiences.mechanism: Unbounded retry hides a terminal failure.
experiences.intervention: Cap attempts and inspect the final result.
limits: Stop when a safety threshold is reached.
transfer_limits: A non-idempotent target needs a different recovery method.

experiences.title: Replace generated files atomically
experiences.problem: Readers observe partially written catalog data.
experiences.intervention: Write a sibling temporary file, sync it, then rename it.
conditions: The temporary file and target share a filesystem.
limits: A rename is not atomic across filesystems.
transfer_limits: Object stores require their native conditional-write operation.

experiences.title: Reject stale competing decisions
experiences.problem: Two reviewers update one decision from the same old state.
experiences.mechanism: An unchecked last write silently overwrites the first.
experiences.intervention: Require the exact previous revision in the transaction.
conditions: The current revision is read in the same transaction.
limits: This does not merge independent edits.
transfer_limits: Distributed stores may need conditional APIs rather than a local transaction.

experiences.title: Address immutable evidence by content hash
experiences.problem: A path changes after a result cites its contents.
experiences.mechanism: Path-only citations cannot identify the original bytes.
experiences.intervention: Store the bytes and cite their digest.
conditions: The digest algorithm and byte encoding are fixed.
limits: A digest does not prove a statement is true.
transfer_limits: Trust and authorization need separate controls.

experiences.title: Bound ingestion with backpressure
experiences.problem: Producers exceed a consumer's sustained rate.
experiences.mechanism: An unbounded buffer moves failure into memory exhaustion.
experiences.intervention: Use a bounded queue and make producers wait or shed work.
limits: This does not increase downstream capacity.
transfer_limits: Loss-intolerant producers must wait rather than shed.

experiences.title: Validate input at the trust boundary
experiences.problem: Malformed records reach storage and fail later.
experiences.mechanism: Shallow transport checks allow invalid nested fields.
experiences.intervention: Validate the complete record before acknowledgment.
limits: Validation does not make supplied facts accurate.
transfer_limits: Existing stored records may need a compatibility reader.

experiences.title: Open legacy stores without mutation
experiences.problem: A read command fails when optional new tables are absent.
experiences.mechanism: The reader assumes the newest write schema.
experiences.intervention: Detect capability and return an explicit uninitialized view.
transfer_limits: Incompatible base schemas still require migration.

experiences.title: Verify downloaded bytes with a checksum
experiences.problem: A transfer may return corrupted bytes.
experiences.mechanism: Transport completion alone does not verify content.
experiences.intervention: Compare a published checksum before use.
conditions: The expected checksum arrives through a trusted channel.
transfer_limits: Authenticity may also require a signature.
